# swap-dimensions

> Return a view of an input ndarray in which two specified dimensions are swapped.

<!-- Section to include introductory text. Make sure to keep an empty line after the intro `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="intro">

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<!-- Package usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var swapDimensions = require( '@stdlib/ndarray/base/swap-dimensions' );
```

#### swapDimensions( x, dims, writable )

Returns a view of an input ndarray in which two specified dimensions are swapped.

```javascript
var array = require( '@stdlib/ndarray/array' );
var getData = require( '@stdlib/ndarray/data-buffer' );

var x = array( [ [ [ 1, 2 ], [ 3, 4 ] ], [ [ 5, 6 ], [ 7, 8 ] ] ] );
// returns <ndarray>[ [ [ 1, 2 ], [ 3, 4 ] ], [ [ 5, 6 ], [ 7, 8 ] ] ]

var y = swapDimensions( x, [ 0, 1 ], false );
// returns <ndarray>[ [ [ 1, 2 ], [ 5, 6 ] ], [ [ 3, 4 ], [ 7, 8 ] ] ]

var bool = ( getData( x ) === getData( y ) );
// returns true
```

The function accepts the following arguments:

-   **x**: input ndarray.
-   **dims**: indices of dimensions to swap. If provided an integer less than zero, the dimension index is resolved relative to the last dimension, with the last dimension corresponding to the value `-1`.
-   **writable**: boolean indicating whether a returned ndarray should be writable.

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<!-- Package usage notes. Make sure to keep an empty line after the `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   The returned ndarray is a **view** of the input ndarray. Accordingly, writing to the original ndarray will **mutate** the returned ndarray and vice versa.
-   If provided an ndarray with fewer than two dimensions, the function raises an exception.
-   The `writable` parameter **only** applies to ndarray constructors supporting **read-only** instances.

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<!-- Package usage examples. -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var array = require( '@stdlib/ndarray/array' );
var ndarray2array = require( '@stdlib/ndarray/to-array' );
var swapDimensions = require( '@stdlib/ndarray/base/swap-dimensions' );

// Create a 2x3 matrix:
var x = array( [ [ 1, 2, 3 ], [ 4, 5, 6 ] ] );
console.log( ndarray2array( x ) );

// Swap dimensions 0 and 1:
var y = swapDimensions( x, [ 0, 1 ], false );
console.log( ndarray2array( y ) );
// => [ [ 1, 4 ], [ 2, 5 ], [ 3, 6 ] ]

// Supports negative dimension indices:
y = swapDimensions( x, [ -2, -1 ], false );
console.log( ndarray2array( y ) );
// => [ [ 1, 4 ], [ 2, 5 ], [ 3, 6 ] ]
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
